mechanism_narrative: Persistent deep negatives in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicate suppressed commuting and office activity, which removes weekday retail footfall; with no improvement in these series, RETAIL_REC remains below its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is greater than or equal to its last-28-day mean while WORKPLACES stays below -46 and TRANSIT stays below -52.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL weekly mean crosses above 15.5, it signals a new stay-at-home order that further curtails non-essential retail trips; RETAIL_REC then falls relative to the last 28 days over a two-week horizon.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL exceeds 15.5 in a week but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not lower than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM remains much less negative than RETAIL_REC, households are concentrating trips on essentials and avoiding discretionary retail; with PARKS also negative, outdoor activity does not spill over into retail, so RETAIL_REC stays depressed over two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean rises above last-28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM stays above -30 and PARKS stays below -30.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime marked by RESIDENTIAL above 15.0 and WORKPLACES below -46.5, capacity limits and remote-work mandates reduce retail footfall; RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: In weeks with RESIDENTIAL > 15.0 and WORKPLACES < -46.5, RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not lower than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT stabilizes above -55.0, it indicates a partial return of subway and bus commuting that supports weekday retail footfall; RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks as a result.
failure_condition: TRANSIT weekly mean exceeds -55.0 but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility means more people are at home in Manhattan neighborhoods, increasing local errands and takeout spending; this lifts RETAIL_REC over the next week.

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL remains above 14.0 but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS dropping below -35.0 signals reduced outdoor activity, likely from seasonal cooling; lower park foot traffic reduces spillover visits to nearby retail, so RETAIL_REC declines over two weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS weekly mean is below -35.0 but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not lower than last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are both deeply negative, restrictions are binding; even if GROCERY_PHARM improves, retail cannot recover because commuting and office footfall remain suppressed, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT < -54.0 and WORKPLACES < -47.0 but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last-28-day mean.
